title: docker_context does not check for 'default' context
body:
#### Current Behavior

When including the `docker_context` module, my prompt says (in a folder where a `Dockerfile` exists):

```
some-project via 🐳 default
❯
```

#### Expected Behavior

Since I am using the `default` context, I expect the module to be hidden:
```
some-project
❯
```

#### Additional context/Screenshots

The [documentation](https://starship.rs/config/#docker-context) states that
> The docker_context module shows the currently active [Docker context (opens new window)](https://docs.docker.com/engine/context/working-with-contexts/) if it's not set to default [...]

My understanding is that it should not be shown if the context set to `default` (which is usually the case if one did not explicitly create a custom context).

#### Possible Solution

The same behavior is mentioned in the source code

https://github.com/starship/starship/blob/master/src/modules/docker_context.rs#L17

but there does not seem to be any kind of check in the module.

#### Environment
- Starship version: 1.5.4
- zsh version: zsh 5.8 (x86_64-apple-darwin21.0)
- Operating system: Mac OS 12.3.0
- Terminal emulator: iTerm.app 3.5.0beta5
- Git Commit Hash: 
- Branch/Tag: 
- Rust Version: rustc 1.59.0
- Rust channel:  release
- Build Time: 2022-03-24 19:12:59 +00:00
